column1: # DARK SOULS: REMASTERED on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# FromSoftware's engine on SDK 4.5.0, update 1.0.3; 3,099 shaders, all translated. 60 fps through the float frame step (game.tsv fps_target, patches.py; Retroid Pocket Nova
# 2026-11-14: 60 fps held, game time 1.000 of real time, ladders fine); DM_FPS_TARGET=30 in env.txt keeps the game's own 30 fps, which the test below ran at.
# Tested 2026-11-06 on the Legion Y700 (TB322FC, Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16), docked: the title, the offline notice, the first-start settings (brightness,
# options, buttons), character creation (the name through the overlay keyboard), the opening movie (skipped with +), the Undead Asylum's first cell (walking, the camera);
# a save and Continue. 30 fps on screen (99% of frames at 33.3 ms, the rest 41.7; 6 long frames in 72 s of walking), GPU about 10 ms; 0 audio underruns.
# The menus confirm with B and go back with A (the game's own prompts), and take short presses: a press of 0.3 s or more repeats in its lists.
# Fixed on the way (core): more than 4,096 memory pools (FATAL "too many memory pools" within 3 s of boot); the scene's bindless textures bound the dummy sampler; integer
# vertex inputs (RG16I / RGBA16I texture coordinates) declared as integers; texture handles the shaders read from memory rebased to the bound pools (the Asylum's walls,
# pillars and floors were drawn as streaks of other textures).

# Pipelines are built where they are first drawn, not on the background thread: a draw skipped while its pipeline builds leaves one pass of this deferred renderer out, and
# the object (the player, the shield, props) flashed grey for a few frames, again with every new material / pass / state combination (994 pipelines and 5,771 skipped draws in
# one session). Retroid Pocket Nova, 2026-11-14: with this the grey flashes are gone and the builds' hitches were not noticed at 60 fps
env
# The rate is held at 60, not adapted: the game's movie player advances by game frames (one movie frame per two), so at the adaptive rate's 40 fps the opening ran at two
# thirds speed and its sound starved (a third of every 10 s was silence), and after the movie the on-screen present times stopped arriving, so the rate swung between 60
# and 40 for the rest of the session (this game's own limiter keeps its frame work at the period). Retroid Pocket Nova, 2026-11-14: pinned, the movies play at their speed
# with sound (29 underruns in 2,000 callbacks) and play stays at 60; the float frame step keeps the game's speed when a frame is late
env
# No dynamic uniform buffers: with graphics pipeline libraries (independent-set layouts, the vertex stage's set 0 and the fragment stage's set 1 both holding dynamic
# uniform buffers) Turnip's fast-linked pipelines read the fragment stage's constant buffers from the wrong dynamic offsets, the vertex stage's: whole objects (the
# player, trees, shields) drew magenta / fluorescent / grey for the frames before the whole pipeline took over, and new areas flashed. Found with DM_VK_SHOTS_FAST
# (the frames a linked pipeline drew, and its shaders): the same pipelines drawn linked in the same scene drew right with this. Retroid Pocket 6 (Adreno 740, Turnip T30),
# 2026-11-15: from empty caches, 60 fps held, no flashes, no pop-in
env
